## Finding my office

Use **entrance 13** of the A-huset building, the entrance closest to my office. Take the staircase directly ahead and go up one floor. Turn back and follow the corridor to the Division of Applied Thermodynamics and Fluid Mechanics at the end on the right. Enter the division corridor (call me if it is locked). Room 3A:970 is in the middle of the corridor.
